vsm2.14:131.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘yaṃkiñci abhisaṅkharaṇalakkhaṇaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ ekato katvā saṅkhārakkhandho veditabbo’’ti, ettha abhisaṅkharaṇalakkhaṇaṃ nāma rāsikaraṇalakkhaṇaṃ.
vsm2.14:131.3: Yathāha – ‘‘saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharontīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā saṅkhārāti vuccantī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 3.79).
vsm2.14:132.5: Evaṃ lakkhaṇādito ekavidhāpi ca jātivasena tividhā kusalā, akusalā, abyākatāti.
vsm2.14:132.6: Tesu kusalaviññāṇasampayuttā kusalā. Akusalasampayuttā akusalā. Abyākatasampayuttā abyākatā.
vsm2.14:133.1: Tattha kāmāvacarapaṭhamakusalaviññāṇasampayuttā tāva niyatā sarūpena āgatā sattavīsati, yevāpanakā cattāro, aniyatā pañcāti chattiṃsa.
vsm2.14:133.2: Tattha phasso, cetanā, vitakko, vicāro, pīti, vīriyaṃ, jīvitaṃ, samādhi, saddhā, sati, hirī, ottappaṃ, alobho, adoso, amoho, kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi, kāyalahutā, cittalahutā, kāyamudutā, cittamudutā, kāyakammaññatā, cittakammaññatā, kāyapāguññatā, cittapāguññatā, kāyujukatā, cittujukatāti ime sarūpena āgatā sattavīsati (dha. sa. 1; dha. sa. aṭṭha. 1 yevāpanakavaṇṇanā).
vsm2.14:133.3: Chando, adhimokkho, manasikāro, tatramajjhattatāti ime yevāpanakā cattāro (dha. sa. aṭṭha. 1 yevāpanakavaṇṇanā).
vsm2.14:133.4: Karuṇā, muditā, kāyaduccaritavirati, vacīduccaritavirati, micchājīvaviratīti ime aniyatā pañca.
vsm2.14:133.5: Ete hi kadāci uppajjanti, uppajjamānāpi ca na ekato uppajjanti.
vsm2.14:134.6: Ayañhi arūpadhammopi samāno ārammaṇe phusanākāreneva pavattati.
vsm2.14:134.7: Ekadesena ca analliyamānopi rūpaṃ viya cakkhu, saddo viya ca sotaṃ cittaṃ ārammaṇañca saṅghaṭṭeti,
vsm2.14:134.8: tikasannipātasaṅkhātassa attano kāraṇassa vasena paveditattā sannipātapaccupaṭṭhāno.
vsm2.14:134.9: Tajjāsamannāhārena ceva indriyena ca parikkhate visaye anantarāyeneva uppajjanato āpāthagatavisayapadaṭṭhānoti vuccati.
vsm2.14:134.10: Vedanādhiṭṭhānabhāvato pana niccammagāvī (saṃ. ni. 2.63) viya daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.14:135.6: Accāyikakammānussaraṇādīsu ca panāyaṃ sampayuttānaṃ ussahanabhāvena pavattamānā pākaṭā hoti.
vsm2.14:136.1: Vitakkavicārapītīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ sabbaṃ pathavīkasiṇaniddese paṭhamajjhānavaṇṇanāyaṃ (visuddhi. 1.71) vuttameva.
vsm2.14:137.5: ‘‘Saṃviggo yoniso padahatī’’ti (a. ni. 4.113) vacanato saṃvegapadaṭṭhānaṃ, vīriyārambhavatthupadaṭṭhānaṃ vā,
vsm2.14:137.6: sammā āraddhaṃ sabbasampattīnaṃ mūlaṃ hotīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
vsm2.14:138.1: Jīvanti tena, sayaṃ vā jīvati, jīvanamattameva vā tanti jīvitaṃ.
vsm2.14:138.3: Tañhi rūpadhammānaṃ jīvitaṃ, idaṃ arūpadhammānanti idamevettha nānākaraṇaṃ.
vsm2.14:139.1: Ārammaṇe cittaṃ samaṃ ādhiyati, sammā vā ādhiyati, samādhānamattameva vā etaṃ cittassāti samādhi.
vsm2.14:139.6: nivāte dīpaccīnaṃ ṭhiti viya cetaso ṭhitīti daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.14:140.1: Saddahanti etāya, sayaṃ vā saddahati, saddahanamattameva vā esāti saddhā.
vsm2.14:140.3: pasādanarasā udakappasādakamaṇi viya, pakkhandanarasā vā oghuttaraṇo viya.
vsm2.14:140.5: saddheyyavatthupadaṭṭhānā, saddhammassavanādisotāpattiyaṅga(dī. ni. 3.311; saṃ. ni. 5.1001) padaṭṭhānā vā,
vsm2.14:141.1: Saranti tāya, sayaṃ vā sarati saraṇamattameva vā esāti sati.
vsm2.14:141.6: Ārammaṇe daḷhapatiṭṭhitattā pana esikā viya, cakkhudvārādirakkhaṇato dovāriko viya ca daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.14:142.2: Tehiyeva ottappatīti ottappaṃ. Pāpato ubbegassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
vsm2.14:142.3: Tattha pāpato jigucchanalakkhaṇā hirī. Uttāsanalakkhaṇaṃ ottappaṃ.
vsm2.14:142.4: Lajjākārena pāpānaṃ akaraṇarasā hirī. Uttāsākārena ottappaṃ.
vsm2.14:142.5: Vuttappakāreneva ca pāpato saṅkocanapaccupaṭṭhānā etā, attagāravaparagāravapadaṭṭhānā.
vsm2.14:142.6: Attānaṃ garuṃ katvā hiriyā pāpaṃ jahāti kulavadhū viya. Paraṃ garuṃ katvā ottappena pāpaṃ jahāti vesiyā viya.
vsm2.14:142.7: Ime ca pana dve dhammā lokapālakāti (a. ni. 2.9) daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.14:143.1: Na lubbhanti tena, sayaṃ vā na lubbhati, alubbhanamattameva vā tanti alobho.
vsm2.14:143.3: Tesu alobho ārammaṇe cittassa agedhalakkhaṇo, alaggabhāvalakkhaṇo vā kamaladale jalabindu viya.
vsm2.14:143.6: Adoso acaṇḍikkalakkhaṇo, avirodhalakkhaṇo vā anukūlamitto viya,
vsm2.14:143.9: Amoho yathāsabhāvapaṭivedhalakkhaṇo, akkhalitapaṭivedhalakkhaṇo vā kusalissāsakhittausupaṭivedho viya,
vsm2.14:144.4: Ubhopi panetā ekato katvā kāyacittadarathavūpasamalakkhaṇā kāyacittapassaddhiyo,
vsm2.14:147.7: Kāyacittānaṃ akammaññabhāvakarāvasesanīvaraṇādipaṭipakkhabhūtā, pasādanīyavatthūsu pasādāvahā, hitakiriyāsu viniyogakkhamabhāvāvahā suvaṇṇavisuddhi viyāti daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.14:150.6: Ārammaṇaggahaṇe ayaṃ cetaso hatthappasāraṇaṃ viya daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.14:152.10: Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno, ārammaṇapaṭipādakattena sampayuttānaṃ sārathi viya daṭṭhabbo.
